anchor.note: 085's DRY refactor is pre-applied in S0 (see design sect. 2.4)

role: ablation: agentic system removed, partial formalization kept, MEMORYLESS ONE-SHOT best-of-N (the no-agent configuration of docs/2026-07-30-ablation-writeup.md; korenblum parity, user decision 2026-07-30)
memoryless: no history window, no build/evaluator feedback, fresh conversation per attempt; the ProofRefinement/Korenblum tree is rsync-reset to the pristine S0 state between attempts, so every attempt is an independent draw from the identical prompt and is evaluated against the V64 parent
selection: best evaluator-accepted candidate across attempts; the workspace is left holding the winning attempt's Korenblum tree
limitation: runs inside Claude Code, so its agentic system prompt is present and some tools remain visible though blocked; weaker than an SDK bare-model call, and biased in the ablation's favour
tools: none (no tool use, no subagents, no file access)

budget.rule: 1x matched window (user decision 2026-07-30): stop before an attempt once active wall > T_ref AND recorded output tokens > O_ref; NO early success stop; one-attempt overshoot possible, recorded
budget.provenance_note: T_ref is floored at the ORIGINAL run's 8322 s band per reference_budget.json; Arm A's measured wall was 3285.4 s -- the floor is generous to this arm
budget.caveat: timed-out calls leave server-side generation unrecorded; recorded tokens are the gate (same convention as B)

stopping_rule: BOTH 1x budgets exhausted: active wall > T_ref and recorded output tokens > O_ref (no early success stop; best sample kept)
disclosures: runs solo: no concurrent A/C CPU contention (favourable to Bos)
static context is built from the pristine S0_korenblum anchor by run_arm_b.build_static_context -- the same starting context Arm B's -01 received; none of B's later artifacts are visible
identical prompt every attempt -> later attempts benefit from prompt-cache reads (cost only; the model sees the same input)

with per-attempt tokens ~125k and the time gate binding, total recorded tokens will overshoot O_ref severalfold before the wall budget exhausts -- generous to this arm, disclose alongside the grothendieck016-armBos overshoot
